thread:
tara: Quick note: sampleapp rerank flaked during onboarding tests. Suspect embed batching helper and auth refresh race.

oscar: repro steps?

tara: burst ingest 300 small docs with batchWindowMs=5 and token TTL 2s. Sometimes embeddings come back with one vector shorter (dims 128 vs 127) and rerank returns 400 or shorter scores array.

hema: seen this before, probably a resend of a partially-built buffer on retry. We should copy buffer before async send.

infra-bot: CI: sampleapp integration unstable (+2 fails last hour).

oscar: mitigation: add pre-send dim validation and pad/trim util in SDKs. Also add rerank server-side check: if scores.length != candidates.length return 502+explain.

tara: I'll open a tiny PR with copy-on-send + rerank validation + doc blurb with pad_or_trim example. Tagging @docs.

hema: QA: run a 1h burst with checksum logging enabled, assert no truncated vectors and rerank never returns partial arrays.

tara: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/sampleapp/pulls/6001 (wip).
